scenes.vo: Last night I looked through my own peephole. The me on the couch opened its eyes. They were red.
I ran for the stairs. This time, they let me go. I woke up on the eighth floor landing, under a buzzing light.
Someone was shaking me. Mrs. Dorsey. Green cardigan, suitcase in her hand. She had come back EARLY.
It doesn't want your door, she said. It wants your VOICE. Then it wears your face, and locks you outside.
But I never answered it, I said. Then I remembered the first night. Half asleep. My lips against the DOOR.
On my very first night, I had whispered Who's there? It has had my VOICE since then.
